name: What is the process for replacing foggy sliding door glass?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing foggy sliding door glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for replacing foggy sliding door glass begins with a consultation where we assess the damage and measure the existing glass unit. We then order a custom-fabricated insulated glass unit (IGU) based on your door's specifications and chosen glass type. Once the new glass arrives, our technicians carefully remove the old, foggy unit from your sliding door frame, ensuring no damage to the surrounding structure. The new IGU is then precisely installed, sealed, and the door is tested for proper operation. We conclude with a clean-up of the work area.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial assessment and measurement, custom glass ordering, removal of the old unit, installation of the new glass, and testing for proper operation.
